plan.description: Read-only planning, design, review, and OpenSpec proposal work. Cannot edit the repo.

build.description: Direct coding agent for small, well-scoped edits. Bump to opus for irreversible changes or when sonnet fails.

orchestrator.description: Master delegator and primary coding agent (oh-my-opencode-slim). Bump to opus for adding new scanners or large refactors.
orchestrator.prompt: Always read AGENTS.md first. Prioritize retrieval-led reasoning over pretrained-knowledge-led reasoning. This is a Go CLI for software supply chain scanning (go.mod, npm lockfiles, OSV API). See SPEC.md for the v1 design. CVE databases and SBOM specs evolve -- use @librarian to verify OSV, SARIF, and registry API details before assuming. Delegate scoped work to specialist agents (explorer, oracle, librarian, fixer) when it improves quality, speed, or cost.

explorer.description: Read-only codebase reconnaissance. High-volume cheap reads.

oracle.description: Architecture advisor and debugger of last resort. Always opus.

librarian.description: External knowledge retrieval (websearch, context7, grep_app). OSV API, CycloneDX spec, SPDX spec, npm registry, Go vuln DB.

designer.description: Terminal output formatting, SARIF structure, report layout.

fixer.description: Fast, scoped implementation worker. Haiku for mechanical edits.
